name: discovery-platform
description: Discovery Platform — an extensible discovery and lead-intelligence engine. Root workspace: install once, then build/test/typecheck every package from here.

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/discovery-core && npm run build -w domains/vacancies
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w packages/discovery-core && tsc --noEmit -p packages/discovery-core/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p domains/vacancies/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/discovery-core && npm run test -w domains/vacancies && npm run test -w examples/basic-discovery && npm run test -w examples/vacancy-discovery
scripts.test:examples: npm run test -w examples/basic-discovery && npm run test -w examples/vacancy-discovery
